items.problem: Spurious '[WARN] MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md exists with content but mapping has no defer rows' fires on every migration that defers zero files.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 2084 & 2115 (WARN through final PASS); seeded MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md contained '| (none) | — |'. Root: Initialize seeds a placeholder row; Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 line 266 only silences the warning on the literal 'No items deferred'.
items.root_cause: Producer/consumer contract mismatch between Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 (writer) and Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 (reader) for the zero-defer case.
items.change: In Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1, when deferredKeys.Count -eq 0, seed MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md with the sentinel line 'No items deferred.' (and skip the table header) instead of writing a '| (none) | — |' placeholder row.
items.expected_effect: Clean (no-defer) migrations produce a DEFERRED.md the validator recognizes, so the zero-defer branch prints '[PASS] No defer rows; MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md correctly notes "No items deferred."'.
items.falsifiable_check: On any re-run with zero deferred files, Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 prints the '[PASS] No defer rows...' line and NO '[WARN] ... check consistency' line.
